name: [UPD 8, CROSS-BREEDING!] My Frog Pond! 🐸
desc:
🐸💚 Grow a Frog!
Raise adorable frogs, sell them for Ribbles, and decorate your pond!
Watch for rare mutations and special weather events to boost your profits!

🌱 Grow frogs even while offline!
🦋 Feed your frog pairs for them to breed!
💖 Your frogs breed even while offline!
💞 Cross-breed your frogs to discover new looks and combinations!
📖 Complete the Frogdex to learn more information about your frogs!
🚀 Ascend to the next tier to unlock a new set of frogs!
🎨 Decorate your pond for style!
⚙️ Equip gears to speed growth and increase mutation chances.
🌦️ Weather bonuses for higher selling prices.
🐸 Play with your friends for bonuses!

💚 Like and Favorite the game for more updates!
Build your dream pond, collect rare frogs, and become the ultimate frog caretaker!
